description: What tokens does wallet X hold + USD value — returns ERC20 token balances with live prices for a wallet address on a given EVM chain. Example: moralis_wallet_tokens({ address: "0xcB1C1FdE09f811B294172696404e88E658659905", chain: "eth", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Moralis API key (get one free — 40k CU/day — at moralis.com)

chain.description: EVM chain: eth (default), polygon, bsc, base, arbitrum, avalanche, optimism, ...

name: moralis_wallet_tokens
